g.text: SMOKE ONLY: no convergence conclusion. 4 paired repetitions; bands are ±1 Monte Carlo SE. Analytic
Bernoulli/deterministic information constants only. Fixed finite static instance, fixed task parameters, interior best
mean. Reference lines are asymptotic, not finite-time guarantees.
